name: THE STOVE MAN
note: A STORY ANCHOR, not a fourth drinker: the man who has not taken his coat off since Thad arrived in this territory. RESTAGED A THIRD TIME BY THE ROOM 3 REBUILD (2026-09-11): the salvaged card cluster is a bigger, nearer table than the plate had, and its right-hand chair and bald player now reach x 1100 -- straight across the 1140 he was standing at. He moves 5 px right, to 1145, where his sprite starts at 1098 and clears the chair, and where his open hands still reach the stove's right side and its lit firebox. The stove's own base line is y 412, 94 px BEHIND the walkable floor's far edge, so nobody can stand level with it; he stands in front of the iron, which is where a man warming himself actually stands. He and the landing man are the room's ONLY runtime actors now: Tyler ruled the seven furniture-dependent patrons into the background art.
poseNote: STANDING just off the stove's right side and overlapping it, turned INTO it, both hands open at chest height toward the iron, coat buttoned to the throat.

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

barksNote: NONE. These nine are the room's population, not its dialogue: doc 07's reputation barks belong to the named ambient cast, and nothing in Tyler's Phase 2A ruling gives a generic patron a line. No written content is invented for them here or anywhere.
